CREATE TABLE "public"."ApplicationUpgradeArchive" (
  "archivedAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,

  "userId" character varying(36),
  CONSTRAINT "ApplicationUpgradeArchive_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("source", "recordId")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ApplicationUpgradeRecurrence" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deletedAt" timestamp(3),
  "legacyId" character varying(36) NOT NULL,
  "recurrenceId" character varying(36) NOT NULL,
  "source" character varying(20) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "userId" character varying(36) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "ApplicationUpgradeRecurrence_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("userId", "source", "legacyId")
)
